title: Tabula device settings (v1)
description: Single source of truth for per-device settings. HA is authoritative (plan 5.6): the integration validates and stores settings, pushes them with set_settings (docs/PROTOCOL.md 4.5) and the device caches them. This file covers only what Phases 1-2 use: identity, connection, screen, screensaver, notifications and audio. Every property carries a role tag (x-tabula-role); profiles may manage only 'shared' keys (F-MGT-03, F-MGT-04). Every leaf property names its behavior in x-tabula-feature (a docs/FEATURES.md item ID, or 'independent design' with the ADR). Defaults come only from docs/decisions/0002-constants.md. A key HA does not send keeps the device default (PROTOCOL 4.5); settings.schema.json versions independently of the protocol (schema_version in set_settings).

identity.description: Who the device is. Never shared by profiles (F-MGT-03).

name.description: Display name of the device in HA. Set at pairing or from the settings editor; unique per device. Length bound per ADR 0002 (identifiers and labels). No default: an unset name falls back to the model or device ID.

connection.description: How the device reaches HA. The only keys the recovery paths may change (F-MGT-11); never shared by profiles.

ha_url.description: Base URL of the HA server (http or https, no trailing slash needed). Relative command paths (navigate, play_media) resolve against it (PROTOCOL 4.5). No default: the device keeps the address it paired with.

screen.description: Panel brightness and power behavior (FEATURES F-SCR). Brightness levels are shared: a profile may carry them, but new profiles start without them (F-MGT-04).

brightness.description: Stored base brightness, percent, applied by the screen light entity (F-SCR-04) and the screen command. Default per ADR 0002.

adaptive_brightness.description: Brightness follows room light through a curve (F-SCR-05). Off until the curve is tuned on real hardware; default per ADR 0002.

keep_screen_on.description: Stop the OS display timeout from turning the panel off while the app is in the foreground (F-SCR-01); the screensaver handles idling. Default per ADR 0002.

enabled.description: Master switch for the idle screensaver (F-SSV-01). Default per ADR 0002.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without interaction before the screensaver starts (F-SSV-01). Default per ADR 0002; the minimum is a non-zero floor, not an ADR value.

mode.description: The screensaver mode used next time it starts (F-SSV-05). Values match the screensaver_mode state key (PROTOCOL 4.4). Default per ADR 0002.

brightness.description: Separate backlight level, percent, while the screensaver shows (F-SSV-17); the previous level returns on dismissal. Default per ADR 0002.

notifications.description: Defaults for on-screen notification cards (FEATURES F-NTF). Per-card fields override these (F-NTF-01).

default_duration.description: Card lifetime in seconds when the notify command sends no duration; 0 means until dismissed. Bounds match the notify command's duration (ADR 0002); default per ADR 0002.

default_level.description: Severity used when a card's level is missing or unknown (F-NTF-02). Values match the notify command's level (PROTOCOL 4.5). Default per ADR 0002.

chime_by_level.description: Whether a card chimes, per severity (F-NTF-09): sound only for what needs attention. Defaults per ADR 0002: chime for warning and error, silent otherwise.

max_visible.description: Cards shown at once; overflow evicts the oldest (F-NTF-07). Default per ADR 0002; the minimum is a non-zero cap, not an ADR value.

audio.description: Volume levels (FEATURES F-TTS). Volume levels are shared: a profile may carry them, but new profiles start without them (F-MGT-04).

media_volume.description: Media channel volume, percent; the level the HA media_player controls (F-TTS-07). Default per ADR 0002.

announce_volume_boost.description: Announcements play at the current volume; no hidden volume jumps. 'none' is the only v1 value (ADR 0002); a boost level, if ever designed, is added with its own ADR and bumps nothing else.
